unit: census tract (each tract one unit; population-weighted variant uses instance_weights = population)

voice_location_basis_detail.rule: participation counts rows with location_basis in ['residence', 'both']; falls back to all located rows when fewer than 30 have that basis; region/map counts always use all located rows

low_income.unprivileged: median_income < city median of tract median incomes

high_lep.unprivileged: pct_lep > 75th percentile of tracts (pandas quantile, linear)

metrics.crosscheck: AIF360 vs pandas, |diff| <= 1e-09, asserted on every computation (weighted and unweighted)
metrics.aif360_weights: BinaryLabelDatasetMetric base rates sum instance_weights, so instance_weights=population gives the population-weighted DI/SPD; verified equal to the pandas weighted formula

counting.voice_default: duplicate_of rows dropped; each campaign_id counts once citywide (split evenly over its rows' tracts)
counting.voice_rate: per 1k residents over the corpus window (not annualized)
counting.unlocated_voice: excluded from geography, reported in totals

correction.population_weight: population_share / comment_share per tract (voice only; null for tracts with no located comments)

gap: expected = population_share x located voice total; gap = (expected - observed) / expected

rules: facts only: population, renter share, LEP share, observed vs expected comments, 311 percentile
never describe what residents of a tract with few comments think or want
never name specific organizations; outreach channels are generic
never present a blended voice + 311 number
channels: community meeting at a nearby library/community center
